snippet.title: Space Warlord Baby Trading Simulator - REVEAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
Space Warlord Baby Trading Simulator is an all-new arcade satire on stock markets and a ruthless exploration of capitalism, based in the same world as Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator. 

Rest assured, this isn’t a game about trading actual babies–we’re not monsters! Instead, players buy stocks based on the simulated lives of babies, profiting from their misery and cashing out the moment they win the Galactic Lottery. See? Nothing to worry about.

Play the demo on Steam today!

STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3642000/Space_Warlord_Baby_Trading_Simulator/
PATREON: https://www.patreon.com/StrangeScaffold
DISCORD: https://discordapp.com/invite/YySjWvM
BLUESKY: https://bsky.app/profile/strangescaffold.bsky.social
